title: Study of 3,662 property managers: AI use reaches 58 percent, but under half see it in the bottom line
summary: AppFolio and the Institute of Real Estate Management released AI Insights 2026 on November 5, 2026, a survey of 3,662 real estate management professionals taken May 7 to June 7, 2026. AI use in the job rose from 21 percent in 2023 to 58 percent, the first time a majority reported using it, and the smallest firms have passed 50 percent. Among users, 85 percent report productivity gains but only 48 percent report a positive effect on net operating income. Only 8 percent of organizations have a written AI policy and 74 percent of professionals have had no formal AI training. Concern is high: 92 percent worry about AI-related cybersecurity and 93 percent about AI-faked applicant documents.
why: Property managers who got results put AI into how the whole operation runs, not into one person's tasks; a one-page AI policy and basic training are the cheapest first steps.
